query:
SELECT o.orderNo, o.orderStatus, o.payoutStatus, o.sellerType, o.paymentMethod, o.cartOrderId, o.listingId,
       ci.id as cartItemId, ci.listingId as ciListingId
FROM marketplaceOrders o
LEFT JOIN cartItems ci ON ci.listingId = o.listingId
WHERE o.orderNo = 'BOXIUM-20260330-7825'
LIMIT 5;
